candidates.line: Your wealth stars feed your officer star: diligence converts into title, resources into standing. You rise by being worth promoting. Negotiate rank as deliberately as you earn.
candidates.reading: A steady engine runs underneath: what you earn keeps converting into standing. Results banked become titles offered, and property and position reinforce each other through your middle decades. The one flaw is under-asking. Negotiate rank as deliberately as you earn it, and make sure someone senior sees the ledger.
candidates.fused_line: In one pillar together, earning and standing braid tightly for you: every gain quietly argues for your next title.
